items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: The mention of 'Sam Fing' occurs in an [INTERVIEWER] turn, not an [INTERVIEWEE] turn. The interviewee does not respond or provide any personal context regarding this individual.

ctx.x: Those Vegas are beautiful. Yeah, it was beautiful. It was beautiful. It was beautiful. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Did you play any other instruments?
I played a little mad one. Well, that's Sam Fing and his violin. He said he got double string on that one.
When you were young, what music do you remember? Music or singing? Very early.
